scope: Legacy-high GF8 AVX2 dense two-parity encoding for K=5..16

implementation.algebra: For source pair (a,b) and fixed legacy coefficient c, compute q=c*(a xor b), then p0 xor= a xor q and p1 xor= b xor q. An odd final a contributes q=c*a, p0 xor= a xor q, p1 xor= q.
implementation.work_reduction: One AVX2 nibble-table GF8 multiply per source pair feeds both parity outputs, without staging the K source shards into transform scratch.
implementation.public_fast_layout: Dense packed source and two-parity slabs, complete 64-byte-multiple shards, ordinary native legacy-high profile.
implementation.fallback: Sparse outputs, ragged sizes, detached public slabs, aliases, and sizes above the measured limit retain the general legacy transform path.
implementation.dispatch_isolation: The existing K=2/3 terminal wrapper remains separate and the new multi-block public dispatch is placed after established neighboring terminal selectors. This removed the first combined wrapper's credible K=2/3 regressions.

methodology.statistic: Mean of five independent log-contrasts with two-sided Student-t 95 percent confidence interval.
methodology.ratio_orientation: Comparator encode time divided by candidate encode time.
methodology.isolation_result: The reserved SMT sibling accumulated zero non-idle jiffies in both exact-main campaigns; frozen binary hashes were unchanged.

correctness.independent_oracle: Direct systematic generator comparison for every K=5..16 across selected and fallback boundaries.
correctness.release: Focused packed and ordinary-production tests passed; the 1024-profile direct encoder suite passed in 76.13 seconds.
correctness.clang18_asan_ubsan_lsan: Focused packed and ordinary-production tests passed with no diagnostic.

runner_correction.invalidated_result: The first wrapper run changed ROOT after importing the reusable runner but failed to recompute its derived RAW global, so it reused pre-kernel JSON files with matching cell names.
runner_correction.resolution: The wrapper now sets both ROOT and RAW before execution. All reported campaigns used new isolated raw directories, checked frozen hashes, matching parity/recovery digests, and clean source attestation.

disposition: Promote. Every exact-main selected cell is a credible win, the same-source matrices contain no credible selected loss or neighboring regression beyond two percent, and all correctness and sanitizer gates pass.
